title: 산속의 그림자
summary: 실종 사건 현장을 찾은 조사팀이 기괴한 발자국을 발견한다

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: 사람이 사라지는 산, 그곳에 그들이 갔다
scenes.shot: Wide shot: [hoon] and [ji] walking through a foggy, dark Korean mountain forest, eerie green lighting, tense expressions, low-angle camera

scenes.speaker: hoon
scenes.shot: Medium shot: [hoon] pointing at a tree with a serious face, dim sunlight filtering through thick fog, close-up on his left cheek scar

scenes.speaker: ji
scenes.shot: Medium shot: [ji] kneeling down with her field notebook, adjusting glasses, pointing at the ground, anxious expression

scenes.speaker: hoon
scenes.shot: Close-up: [hoon] looking down at the ground, wide eyes, flashlight beam illuminating giant, clawed footprints in the mud

scenes.speaker: ji
scenes.line: 뼈가 변형된 형태예요, 동물 게 아닙니다
scenes.shot: Close-up: [ji] shining a UV light on the footprint, glowing residue, terrified expression, shaking hands

scenes.speaker: sang
scenes.line: 거기서 당장 나와, 밤이 되면 놈들이 와
scenes.shot: Medium shot: [sang] suddenly appearing from behind a tree, holding an old lantern, rugged face illuminated by flickering firelight

scenes.speaker: hoon
scenes.shot: Medium shot: [hoon] standing up quickly, grabbing his jacket, defensive posture, staring at [sang] with suspicion

scenes.speaker: sang
scenes.line: 이미 늦었어, 그 그림자가 너희를 보고 있다
scenes.shot: Extreme close-up: [sang] whispering with wide, panicked eyes, background suddenly going pitch black with a heavy breathing sound

cta: 과연 조사팀의 운명은? 다음 화를 기대하고 구독하세요!
description: 산속 실종 사건의 진실을 파헤치는 조사팀, 그들이 마주한 첫 번째 공포.
